msContents.summary: This copy of the third volume of the Vīramāheśvarācārasaṃgraha was digitized by the eGangotri project as part of the Jangamwadi Math Collection in 2022. For more information on the text, see Fisher 2021.

lg.l:
yad danam abhayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadānottamaṃ śu
bham ||
tasmāt tu parihartavyā hiṃsā sarvatra sarvadā || 12 ||

manasā ka
rmaṇā vācā sarvadā'hiṃsakaṃ naram ||

rakṣaṃti jantavaḥ sarve hiṃsakaṃ vā
dhayaṃti ca || 13 ||
trailokyam akhilaṃ datvā yat phalaṃ vedapārage ||

tat phalaṃ
koṭiguṇitaṃ labhate 'hiṃsako naraḥ || 14 ||

manasā karmaṇā vācā sarva
bhūtahite ratāḥ ||
dayādarśitapaṃthāno iṃdralokaṃ vrajanti te || 15 ||

svā
mivat parirakṣanti bahūni vividhāni ca ||
putravat pautravat svnehād rudralokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 16 ||
trailokyam akhilaṃ hatva yat pāpaṃ parikīrtitam ||

śi
vālaye nihatyaikam api tat sakalaṃ labhet || 17 ||
saphalaṃ hi tapas teṣaṃ śrutaṃ sādhutvam eva vā ||

jīvitaṃ
ca tathaiśvaryaṃ ye 'rcayaṃtyamareśvaram || 14 ||

tasmāt tam evam īśanaṃ śreyo 'rthī pū
jayāmy aham ||
gṛhītaniyamo nityaṃ kāla kalpadrumopamam || 15 ||

na jī
vitaṃ kalatraṃ ca na rājyaṃ na tathā sukham ||
priyaṃ mama yathātīva loke 'smiṃc chivapūjanam || 16 ||
yathā ca nānṛtaṃ vācam aham etām ihoktavān ||
satyenānena satataṃ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ || 17 ||
tam abravīt tataḥ kālaḥ prahasann iva bhūpatim || 18 ||
|| na śrutaṃ tu tvayā manye vṛddhānāṃ śveta jalpitam ||
pūrve vayasi yo dharmaṃ na karoti vimūḍhadhīḥ || 19 ||

sa paścāt tapyate supto
mraṣṭasārtha ivādhvagaḥ ||
idaṃ kṛtam idaṃ kāryam idam anyat kṛtākṛtam || 20 ||
evam īhāsamāyuktaṃ kālaḥ saṃharate naram ||

nākāle mriyate jantur vidduḥ
śaraśataiḥ sitaiḥ || 21 ||
kuśāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ praptakāle na jīvati ||
śvaḥ kāryam adya kurvīta pūrvāṇhe caparāṇyikam || 22 ||

na hi pratīkṣate
kālaḥ kṛtam asya na va kṛtam ||

garbhe vāpy artha vālye va vārddhake yauvane
'pi vā || 23 ||
āyuṣye karmaṇi kṣīṇe loko 'yaṃ nyiyate mayā ||

naupa
dhāni na maṃtrāś ca na homā na punar japāḥ || 24 ||

trāyante mṛtyunopetaṃ jara
thāpi ca manavam ||
cakravartisahasrāṇi puraṃdaraśatāni ca || 25 ||

mayā
tīrtāni kartavyo nātra manyus tvayā nagha ||

tṛṣṇāsūcivinirbhinnān_ si
ktān_ viṣayayāriṇā || 26 ||
